name: The Flesh Crucible
source:
An eerie horror novel that puts you smack in the middle of a fleshy prison. Your mission is to... escape? Or is it to explore the flesh deeper? It all depends on your choices, as this VN has different endings for all types of readers. Will you meet your end, or will you flourish in the horror?

[From [url=https://dopamineloop.itch.io/the-flesh-crucible]itch.io[/url]]
